Name: Make Love Female Furry Replacer
Author: Emreld3000
Description:
This is just a basic sprite replacement to make MakeLove furry.

Take these images and place them into

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\MakeLove\assets or wherever you put your mods.

Sprites are ripped from Plebby999's mods, Xtarfur Valley mostly specifically. Give them a look https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Plebby999/mods?gameId=1303

It's pretty rough, but it should be enough to not break immersion...but I'm just using sprites already available in a new context.

I plan on doing the same for the Expanded bachelorettes + the Witch as well.
